note: not part of the registered experiment; validation-year profiles; storage not simulated in the scheduler
title: Move what you can, store for what you can't

window.drain: arrivals stop at A; the window runs on until the last cohort job ends, so the cluster's load falls over the final hours (the drain)
window.rule: the registered cohort window: eval_start to the last hour a cohort job (U, or W under mobility ≤ 8 GPUs) still runs

assumptions.losses: round-trip losses charged on the charging side (stores η × grid draw)
assumptions.power_limit: charging ≤ min(P, connection − cluster load); discharge ≤ min(P, cluster load); connection = 2,288 GPUs × 0.60 kW × PUE 1.20
assumptions.state_of_charge: chronological over the whole window, starting empty; energy left at the end is valued at zero
assumptions.ignored: degradation, self-discharge, auxiliary loads, capital cost
assumptions.load: cohort jobs only (warm-up occupancy not included), exact hourly overlap

schedule.rule: charge in the 6 local hours with the lowest training-mean CI, discharge in the 6 highest of the rest, every day

strategy_labels.A: fixed daily schedule (training-year hours, no forecasts)
strategy_labels.B: hindsight heuristic (sees each day's actual carbon in advance; one possible plan, not a limit)

break_even.rule: storage cuts CO₂ only if charging intensity / η < displaced intensity

marginal_threshold.kind: threshold scenario (no defensible hourly marginal assignment)
marginal_threshold.source: docs/data-profile/grid.md §8: PACE ΔCO₂/Δnet-load OLS slopes, all hours 618 g/kWh and by local 6-hour block (00–06, 06–12, 12–18, 18–24 h), validation year, R² 0.47. An associational reference, not a causal marginal factor, and not the spec §10 training-only proxy (not built), so it gives no defensible hourly assignment.
marginal_threshold.flat_rule: −(charged − delivered) × 618 g/kWh: losses plus energy left stored at the end; per strategy and η in cases.*.strategies (flat_marginal_cut_t)

rush.rule: validation hours with PACE net load ≥ the training years' 99% quantile (training-derived threshold)

peak_relief.rule: each site's cluster load (cohort, registered ledgers) during the rush hours and at PACE's net-load peak hour; change vs U; MW = MWh per hour

combined.rule: move small, store for big: (U − (W under mobility ≤ 8 GPUs − storage cut on its Utah load)) / U over the registered cohort window, η 0.85; Utah execution, remote execution and transfer energy each counted once; ratio of totals, not the registered 4-week-block estimate

headline.rule: illustrative selection (lead ruling, T10b fix round 1): 4 MWh / 1 MW, sized to the charging room the site connection leaves free; not an optimum
headline.plateau_rule: the smallest size whose fixed-schedule (A) cut, U load, η 0.85, is at least 90% of A's largest cut over the size grid

connection_plus_25.rule: the site connection × 1.25 (2.059 MW), U load, η 0.85

power_quality: Fast power-quality buffering (seconds to minutes) is a future interface, outside the hourly model.
